title: Echo Phrases
body: An echo phrase is when a musical idea is repeated — often at a different pitch or dynamic. It's one of the oldest tricks in music: play something, then answer it. Call and response.

title: The Phrase and Its Echo
caption: Bar 1 rises: E F G A. Bar 2 falls back: A G F E. The descent is the echo — same notes, reversed direction. This mirror shape appears everywhere in classical and folk music.
